name: @settora/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Settora (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle participants --output src/.bundled/participants.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle participants --output src/.bundled/participants.json && redocly bundle deals --output src/.bundled/deals.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle deals --output src/.bundled/deals.json && redocly bundle breaks --output src/.bundled/breaks.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle breaks --output src/.bundled/breaks.json && redocly bundle settlements --output src/.bundled/settlements.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle settlements --output src/.bundled/settlements.json && redocly bundle finality --output src/.bundled/finality.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle finality --output src/.bundled/finality.json && redocly bundle collateral --output src/.bundled/collateral.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle collateral --output src/.bundled/collateral.json && redocly bundle governance --output src/.bundled/governance.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle governance --output src/.bundled/governance.json && redocly bundle supervision --output src/.bundled/supervision.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle supervision --output src/.bundled/supervision.json
